description: StreetLight Data sells transportation metrics through an online platform. Its freight product provides preprocessed truck volumes, origin-destination flows and congestion metrics for all major roads, truck AADT and speed at segment level, and analysis by vehicle weight class, industry and route type; other products cover traffic volumes for vehicles and bicycle and pedestrian activity. Planners use it for freight corridor studies, bottleneck analysis, statewide freight planning and freight resiliency plans that identify the corridors most critical for supply chains; one case study describes Caltrans and Kittelson & Associates studying truck movement in Alameda County, California. Coverage is United States roads in the material read. Access: a commercial product with dashboards, requested through the vendor's get-started form. Caveats: the methods behind the metrics are not documented on the pages read, and pricing is not published. It supports network flow and freight resilience analysis, capacity planning and calibration of traffic models where counts are sparse, and complements the Freight Analysis Framework and Strava Metro catalogued here.
